content:
Dear all,

My name is Dean, and I am a student at New York University. I am seeking topology and homotopy enthusiasts who might be interested in a project which demonstrates the Whitehead theorem for Mathlib's simplicial sets. Forgive me if I'm wrong, but I don't think that Mathlib has this. Meanwhile the approach I have outlined extensively makes thorough and intimate use of Mathlib's features, as well as using such structures as internal groupoids and internal G-presheaves (themselves using Mathlib's category and bicategory structures). At the end of the project outline, we will be able to do things like:

  • Calculate π₂(ℂℙ∞)
  • Calculate π₁ of the wedge of one-spheres
  • The long exact sequence (Puppe sequence)
  • ΩBG≅G

Please reach out to edeany@nyu.edu with "Whitehead Theorem for Lean 4" for more information, or if you would like to participate.

October 12th Edit: the mentioned outline is available here
Cool project! I suggest discussion and questions take place at: https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/116395-maths/topic/Whitehead.20Theorem
